en.title: Midnight Diner Parfait and the Quivering of the Stopped Clock
en.premise: In the corner of a sleepless city, I work as a night‑shift diner clerk. The menu’s highlight is a sparkling, star‑shaped special parfait. One evening, a customer brings a broken pocket watch whose hands are frozen. When it starts ticking again, the city’s magic loosens just a touch, and forgotten memories melt into sweet desserts. Amid bustling nights and delicious treats, a slightly mysterious slice of everyday life unfolds.

zh.title: 午夜餐厅冰淇淋与停摆时针的颤动
zh.premise: 在这座不眠城市的角落，我在一家只在深夜营业的餐厅当店员。招牌菜是星尘般闪耀的特制冰淇淋！有一天，顾客送来一只停在原地的“坏掉的怀表”。当那表重新走动，城市的魔法微微解开，遗忘的珍贵记忆化作甜蜜的甜点，慢慢融化。喧闹的夜晚与美味的甜点环绕，展开一段略带神秘的日常故事。
